asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

defaultValue.description:
The initial value of the rating when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the rating.

form.description: The associate form of the underlying input element.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the rating. Useful for composition.

name.description: The name attribute of the rating element (used in forms).

onHoverChange.description: Function to be called when the rating value is hovered.

onValueChange.description: Function to be called when the rating value changes.
